stories.title: NFL training camp updates: Camp standouts and key questions for all 32 teams
stories.summary: Get all the latest news, intel and insights on NFL training camps from our team of reporters in the field.

stories.title: LIV players mixed after meeting proposed investor
stories.summary: With LIV Golf's future still murky, players met with CEO Scott O'Neil and the league's proposed new investor Tuesday for about 50 minutes, and while some claimed progress was made, others were noncommittal.

stories.title: Kyrgios reveals he tested positive for cocaine
stories.summary: Former Wimbledon finalist Nick Kyrgios revealed on Wednesday he tested positive for cocaine and was provisionally suspended from tennis.

stories.title: Mitchell, Clark set mark for WNBA duo in Fever win
stories.summary: Kelsey Mitchell scored 16 points in the first quarter and finished with 29 before sitting out the fourth, Caitlin Clark added 24 points and the Fever beat the Tempo 101-95 on Tuesday for their fifth straight victory.

stories.title: Brewers tie largest shutout with 22-0 rout of M's
stories.summary: The Brewers equaled baseball's modern-era record for the largest shutout with a power surge that included three-run homers from Christian Yelich, David Hamilton and Luis Lara and a two-run shot by Jake Bauers in a 22-0 win over the Mariners on Tuesday.
